If you (a) have multiple Franchised Businesses operating in multiple Designated Territories, or (b) otherwise get our prior written approval, then (i) you may determine to appoint a manager to run the day-to-day operations of any additional Business within its corresponding territory (the “Designated Manager”), and (ii) this Designated Manager must participate in and complete all components of the initial training disclosed above that we designate.
